scope: One isolated execution of frozen G287 runner solely to acquire and inspect a candidate; no raw admission, blackbox qualification, startup or device execution.

checks.environment: Current local_env config SHA equals frozen 5ce3a58541ef1711890aad8348c3a31a03203f584fa50f1f5c0cb4fd88b49718; project/evidence root and container=forbidden bindings match. Curl/aapt2/apksigner/java present and exact pinned SHAs match.
checks.live_source_gate: At runtime, HTTPS official page /download must return HTTP 200, TLS verification 0, no redirect, <=600000 body bytes, and contain exact underscore Lite APK URL. Alternate hyphen variant cannot satisfy exact URL. This was reviewed statically/local fixture; no live network request made by reviewer.
checks.head_gate: Fresh HEAD on same exact HTTPS CDN URL requires HTTP 200, TLS 0, no redirect, exactly one Content-Length=35983713 and one APK MIME. HEAD command max-time 20 and subprocess timeout 25.
checks.network_bounds: Page: curl max-time 25, max-filesize 600000, subprocess timeout 30 and post-size check. APK GET: exact URL, max-time 180, max-filesize 35983713, retry 0, no follow/resume, subprocess timeout 190; require download 200/TLS0/redirect0 and both transfer and file byte count exact. No fallback GET path.
checks.one_shot: Durable O_EXCL START precedes environment checks and HTTP. Existing START rejects replay. Terminal RESULT is link-created without replacement; failures and SIGTERM become TERMINAL_FAILED when RESULT can be written. Absent RESULT after START means UNKNOWN, no blind replay.
checks.postchecks: Staging must be new; observed APK SHA and final postguard, ZIP CRC and exactly one manifest, aapt2 package/version/min/target SDK, only arm64-v8a or no lib ABI, apksigner verify v2/v3, one signer and observed cert SHA; all tools have before/after SHA guards.
checks.claim_boundary: No publisher artifact digest or publisher certificate anchor exists. Computed SHA proves received bytes only; signature verification proves integrity under observed cert, not publisher attribution. Result sets raw_accepted=false, blackbox_qualified=false, overseas_mainstream_qualified=false and canonical_delta=0.

limitations: Official page binding is a runtime gate, not an independent publisher SHA/certificate proof.
HEAD header dump has no explicit file-size cap; curl/request timeouts bound duration, and no APK is admitted on abnormal HEAD or later failure.
This review did not run page, HEAD or APK network requests; live success and actual APK identity require post-run evidence review.
acceptance_condition: Execute only exact pinned runner SHA once under project environment loader and bounded outer deadline; preserve START, RESULT, raw command streams, payload and observed hashes for independent post-run review. Do not count raw or blackbox from this pre-review.
